llmnav-catalog/1 repository=llmnav catalog=llmnav.search
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@llmnav.search.query
role Rank cards from task language and pack confidence-weighted repository graph context.
owns query ranking, graph ranking, multilingual aliases, context expansion
excludes embedding generation, source mutation
rel workflow>llmnav.index.generate, workflow>llmnav.index.inverted, workflow>llmnav.graph.generate

@llmnav.search.tokenize
role Normalize task text and emit deterministic word and CJK n-gram tokens for semantic retrieval.
owns query normalization, CJK n-grams, tokenizer version
excludes card ranking, inverted-index persistence
rel workflow>llmnav.search.query

@llmnav.search.discover
role Find source files and heuristic declarations before a repository has semantic cards or generated indexes.
owns unannotated source navigation, file and declaration ranking, candidate provenance
excludes business rule inference, source mutation, semantic ID assignment
invariant Automatic candidates carry source provenance and never claim reviewed semantic contracts.
rel workflow>llmnav.declaration.extract, workflow>llmnav.audit.coverage

@llmnav.search.source-pack
role Pack live literal source matches beside compact semantic boundaries for a coding task.
owns literal source windows, shared source byte budget, source coordinates and hashes
excludes complete change impact inference, source mutation, semantic contract inference
invariant Source evidence is live, repository-contained and explicitly bounded; omissions never imply absence of dependencies.
